title: Length of concatenated list blocks
statement: Let $g$ assign a list to each natural number, and let $K,c$ be natural numbers. If $g(j)$ has length $c$ for every $j<K$, then concatenating the lists $g(0),\ldots,g(K-1)$ produces a list of length $Kc$.
